## `#[AsWebhookReceiver]`

`Semitexa\Webhooks\Auth\Attribute\AsWebhookReceiver`

Applies to: class

| parameter | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `secretRef` | `string` | yes |
| `replayWindowSeconds` | `int` | no |
| `verificationMode` | `string` | no |
| `name` | `string` | no |
